notes: lz4.c and lz4hc.c are built together as one translation unit through Lz4Unity.c (the LZ4_SRC_INCLUDED approach upstream supports). The -Wunused-function suppression branch of lz4hc.c is inactive in this approach.

lz4frame.c and xxhash.c are compiled separately. The upstream amalgamation (lz4.c, lz4hc.c, lz4frame.c in that order) has lz4frame.c reuse lz4.c's ALLOC macro, but LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY_DISABLE_MEMORY_ALLOCATION turns that macro into a compile error marker, so they cannot be combined. The separately compiled lz4frame.c does not use lz4.c's allocation API (LZ4_createStream and the like). xxhash.c is a separate translation unit in the upstream amalgamation as well.

XXH_NAMESPACE=LZ4_: renames LZ4's xxHash 0.6.5 symbols to LZ4_XXH32 and the like. zstd sets XXH_NAMESPACE to ZSTD_ in its own xxhash.h, so the symbols do not collide when both libraries are linked together. lz4frame.c and xxhash.c receive the same definitions.

LZ4F allocation: the adapter passes both allocation and free functions to LZ4F_createCompressionContext_advanced and LZ4F_createDecompressionContext_advanced (LZ4F_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY, experimental API since v1.9.4), so every LZ4F allocation goes through the Rocks Allocator. lz4frame.c keeps default allocation paths used when there is no user allocator (LZ4F_compressFrame, LZ4F_createCompressionContext, LZ4F_createDecompressionContext, LZ4F_createCDict). LZ4_USER_MEMORY_FUNCTIONS (an upstream configuration point) connects those paths to LZ4_malloc, LZ4_calloc and LZ4_free in Lz4Unity.c, and these functions return NULL, so accidentally taking a default path becomes an allocation failure instead of the CRT. lz4.c is unaffected because its DISABLE_MEMORY_ALLOCATION branch comes first. XXH32_createState and XXH64_createState in xxhash.c call the CRT malloc directly, but lz4frame.c keeps its state inside the context and does not use these functions (Docs/Design/Compression.ko.md section 12.2).
LZ4F_MULTITHREAD is not defined (default 0: thread code is not compiled and only nbWorkers 0 is used).

Uses LZ4_compress_fast_extState_fastReset (LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY, defined by lz4hc.h under LZ4_HC_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY) and LZ4_STREAMHC_EXTSIZE and LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC_fastReset (LZ4_HC_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY, experimental API in v1.11). With external state, levels 10-12 also allocate nothing during compression. The LZ4F HC state uses the same external size. Static linking and a pinned version allow the experimental APIs.
LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY_DISABLE_MEMORY_ALLOCATION removes the allocation APIs of lz4.c and lz4hc.c at compile time.

LZ4FLIB_VISIBILITY=: removes the visibility("default") lz4frame.h adds on the GNU family (same reason as LZ4LIB_VISIBILITY=). lz4frame_static.h (a compatibility header that defines LZ4F_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY and includes lz4frame.h) is not imported because LZ4F_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY in consumerDefines replaces it.
